name: Section
purpose: Groups part of a screen under a title, with a line saying what it's for if it needs one, and spaces it from what's above, so a long screen reads as a few clear parts: such as Check vehicle details, Status or Registered to.

origin.notes: The app's VehicleCheckSectionView heads Check vehicle details this way: its title in Title 3, bold (which measures semibold), its description in Subheadline 8pt below, and its card 16pt below that. VehicleDetailView puts its section titles, such as Registered to, 32pt below what's above them, which a section does on a screen. Something beside the title, such as a number plate, is from the future driving designs.

title.description: Its title, such as Check vehicle details.

description.description: A line under the title saying what it's for, such as Tax and MOT information for any vehicle.

level.description: The title's place in the screen's outline. Drawn as h2 to h4.

inputs.content: What the section holds, such as a grouped list or an address, top to bottom, 16pt apart. Something with slot="accessory", such as a <govuk-app-number-plate>, goes on the right of its title.

rules: Use sections to break a long screen into a few parts, each with a title that says what's in it.
Give it a description only when the title alone doesn't say what the section is for.
Put sections one after another in a screen: each is spaced from what's above it, as the app spaces its sections. The first on a screen isn't.
For a list with a title and nothing else, a grouped list's own title is enough.

avoid.when: For a list of rows that needs only a title
For a section the user can act on as a whole, such as a widget with Edit
To put a few components side by side

ios.symbol: its section titles, such as Registered to

references.description: Check vehicle details, with its description, in light mode
Registered to, 32pt below what's above it

examples.name: With a description
examples.html:
<govuk-app-section title="Check vehicle details" description="Tax and MOT information for any vehicle">
  <govuk-app-grouped-list>
    <govuk-app-grouped-list-row name="check-vehicle">Search for a vehicle</govuk-app-grouped-list-row>
  </govuk-app-grouped-list>
</govuk-app-section>

examples.name: Something beside its title
examples.html:
<govuk-app-section title="Overview">
  <govuk-app-number-plate slot="accessory">LH09 PZ2</govuk-app-number-plate>
  <govuk-app-grouped-list background="subtle">
    <govuk-app-grouped-list-row name="tech-specs">Tech specs</govuk-app-grouped-list-row>
  </govuk-app-grouped-list>
</govuk-app-section>

examples.name: Sections one after another, on a screen
examples.html:
<govuk-app-screen background="modal">
  <govuk-app-section title="Status">
    <govuk-app-grouped-list background="subtle">
      <govuk-app-grouped-list-row type="information" detail="Valid">Tax</govuk-app-grouped-list-row>
    </govuk-app-grouped-list>
  </govuk-app-section>
  <govuk-app-section title="Registered to">
    <govuk-app-address name="Mrs Jane Bloggs">
      75 St John's Street
      Gateshead
      NE8 2ED
    </govuk-app-address>
  </govuk-app-section>
</govuk-app-screen>
